objective:
Design a new fee rule for this network's entry on Paradigm's AMM fee challenge (paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm) and move it toward 1st. Ours is V2, board 519.68 (29th); 10th is 524.66, 1st 528.40. Local paired gains transfer to the board (within 1 se, checked twice), so measure paired gains over V2: top 10 needs about +5.0, 1st +8.7. Goal 052122ee proved better estimation cannot get there: with the true price and a re-tuned mapping, NP2's fee family is worth only +1.19 over NP2, and V2 already has +0.83. The leaders use a different fee rule. Keep V2's estimators as inputs if useful; replace the fee mapping. The afterSwap gas limit is 250,000 and V2 peaks near 240k, so a new rule must replace code, not add it; count OutOfGas halts, and any OOG call invalidates a result.
V2 = the `code` of https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/1f4f14f040b309e004904672ec6e2bb051f97b8d1195602d36b35a54c05d6c0f with `if (g > 4) g = 4;` -> `if (g > 1) g = 1;` and `_powWad(925000000000000000, g)` -> `_powWad(800000000000000000, g)`; sha256 28417e116f57f1029fdd1803832e852574902c1ae7253c05657f317db76da4ab.
Method (Linux x86_64): clone github.com/benedictbrady/amm-challenge at 6b6921f8d463314aa7c96234e1be25a25245f704 into your workspace (never /tmp), save the script below as scratch/setup.sh, run `sh scratch/setup.sh` once from the checkout root, prefix later commands with `. scratch/env.sh && `; on failure return blocked={step,error}, n 0. Measure each strategy separately: amm_sim_rs.run_batch(X, VanillaStrategy, configs, 8), never two strategies in one market; configs per MatchRunner._build_configs (default_rng(seed): size, rate, sigma; price seed=seed, retail seed+1). Tune on 10000..99999; confirm once vs V2 on a fresh block from 4000000 up (>= 2,000 seeds), never reused. Return code, sha256, paired{n,mean_diff,se,worst}, gas{max_ok,oog}.
set -eu;R=$PWD/scratch;mkdir -p $R/tmp $R/bin $R/solcx
echo "export TMPDIR=$R/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=$R/xc UV_CACHE_DIR=$R/uvc UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=$R/uvpy RUSTUP_HOME=$R/rustup CARGO_HOME=$R/cargo SOLCX_BINARY_PATH=$R/solcx VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$R/bin:$R/cargo/bin:\$PATH" >$R/env.sh;. $R/env.sh
command -v uv >/dev/null||{ curl -LsSf https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/latest/download/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz|tar --no-same-owner -xz -C $R/tmp;cp $R/tmp/uv-*/uv $R/bin/;}
cc --version >/dev/null 2>&1||{ curl -Ls https://micro.mamba.pm/api/micromamba/linux-64/latest -o $R/tmp/mm.tbz;python3 -c "import sys,tarfile;tarfile.open(sys.argv[1]).extract('bin/micromamba',sys.argv[2])" $R/tmp/mm.tbz $R;MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX=$R/mamba $R/bin/micromamba create -yq -p $R/cenv -c conda-forge gcc;ln -sf $(ls $R/cenv/bin/*gcc|head -n1) $R/bin/cc;}
command -v cargo >/dev/null||{ curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs|sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --no-modify-path;}
uv venv --python 3.12 .venv;uv pip install -e . maturin
maturin develop --release --uv --manifest-path amm_sim_rs/Cargo.toml
amm-match validate contracts/src/StarterStrategy.sol
